name: Combat Duration and Stalemate Semantics Closure
safeAutomaticStalemateRule: terminate unresolved only when both primary weapons are permanently out of finite ammunition and no already-launched missile flights remain
turnCapPolicy: TURN_CAP_SENTINEL is a gameplay/design diagnostic, never an invitation to extend combat duration
longCombatPolicy: resolved combat at 25 or more turns is a gameplay-duration concern and remains a first-class viability metric
diagnosticPolicy: turn-cap dominant signals are transparent descriptive partitions; only mutual finite offensive exhaustion changes termination timing
